name: Hotel Le Marais
description: Charming boutique hotel in the heart of Le Marais district. Walking distance to museums and cafes. Elegant rooms with modern amenities.

name: Grand Hotel Paris
description: Luxury 5-star hotel near the Eiffel Tower. Michelin-starred restaurant and rooftop bar. Spa and fitness center available.

name: Budget Inn Montmartre
description: Affordable accommodation near Sacré-Cœur. Clean rooms with basic amenities. Perfect for backpackers and budget travelers.

name: Bali Beach Resort
description: Beachfront resort with stunning ocean views. Private beach access and water sports. Traditional Balinese architecture.

name: Ubud Jungle Villa
description: Peaceful retreat surrounded by rice terraces. Yoga classes and organic restaurant. Infinity pool overlooking jungle.

name: Kuta Surf Hostel
description: Budget-friendly hostel steps from Kuta Beach. Surf lessons and board rentals. Social atmosphere for young travelers.

name: Rome Colosseum Suites
description: Modern apartments with Colosseum views. Self-catering kitchen and terrace. Central location near ancient ruins.

name: Vatican Luxury Hotel
description: 5-star elegance near Vatican City. Art-filled interiors and fine dining. Concierge service for Vatican tours.

name: Trastevere Guesthouse
description: Cozy B&B in charming Trastevere neighborhood. Homemade breakfast and local tips. Family-run with personal touch.

name: London Thames View
description: Contemporary hotel on the Thames riverbank. Floor-to-ceiling windows with river views. Near Tower Bridge and attractions.

name: Shoreditch Design Hotel
description: Hip boutique hotel in trendy Shoreditch. Street art decor and rooftop terrace. Close to markets and nightlife.

name: Kings Cross Budget
description: Simple accommodation near King's Cross station. Easy access to trains and city center. Clean rooms at great prices.

name: Tokyo Shibuya Hotel
description: Modern high-rise in bustling Shibuya. Panoramic city views and Japanese-style rooms. Walking distance to shopping.

name: Kyoto Ryokan Experience
description: Traditional Japanese inn with tatami rooms. Onsen baths and kaiseki meals. Cultural immersion in historic setting.

name: Capsule Pod Akihabara
description: Futuristic capsule hotel in electronics district. Compact sleeping pods with entertainment systems. Budget-friendly tech experience.
